item.text:
Audited [wavaila-alamdar.md](src/data/lyrics/wavaila-alamdar.md) verse by verse. Corrected Roman spellings and nasal vowels, restored omitted words, and preserved the Urdu text, metadata, and stanza layout.

The Shimr verse retains the unusual wording `sara` and `sar bhi` from the Urdu. That reading remains open for editorial review.
